description: This file declares TypeScript modules, classes, types, and methods for the Microsoft Teams SDK, providing type definitions for interacting with Microsoft Teams APIs and middleware.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Represents a Microsoft Teams application with methods to obtain tokens.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Client for interacting with Microsoft Teams API, including conversations and activities.

classes.name: JwtValidator
classes.description: Performs JWT validation for Microsoft Teams authentication tokens.

methods.name: App.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the App with client ID, client secret, and optional tenant ID.

methods.name: App.getAppGraphToken
methods.description: Retrieves the app graph token asynchronously.

methods.name: Client.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the client with service URL and optional token and headers.

methods.name: Client.conversations.activities
methods.description: Accesses activities within a conversation to create new activities.

methods.name: JwtValidator.constructor
methods.description: Constructs a JWT validator with provided options.

methods.name: JwtValidator.validateAccessToken
methods.description: Validates an access token with optional service URL validation.

methods.name: createServiceTokenValidator
methods.description: Factory function to create a token validator for a given app ID and optional tenant ID.
